title: Partner DD red finding on IP title, chain, or encumbrances conflicting with our exclusivity
thresholds_source: docs/decisions/2026-08-24-evidence-source-backlog-disposition.md (round 4) + ADR-0060 row wording; surfaces via migration 0031 — threshold by criterion wording (ADR-0060)
notes: Design section A.4 [rbd 2.3, 2.6]: a red partner-DD finding on IP title/chain or encumbrances that conflicts with the exclusivity the deal shape depends on. Declared in YAML, not yet executable — predicate null by design until the thresholds meeting sets what counts as a red finding in machine-readable form (ADR-0052 open questions; activation convention per ADR-0057). Classification (ADR-0060): class (iii) — no snapshot var; proposed: partner.dd_ip_red (boolean) — tech.ip_ownership_status covers the target's dd_finding, not partner DD. ADR-0067 arms this: partner.dd_ip_chain_red_count >= 1 halts — red findings on IP title/chain/encumbrance conflicting with deal exclusivity (workstream='ip_chain', severity='red').
evaluable_from_evidence: partner.dd_ip_chain_red_count; partner DD needs a named partner after the shape evaluation (S7, Short List; the shape evaluation moved from S4 on 2026-11-08, so evaluable_from moved S5 -> S8 with the project-scoped partner source); project-scoped source (partner_dd_finding.project_id NOT NULL); listed at pre_fs (flow.spec 2.20.0) but deferred to fs, the first project gate - no opportunity source, no proxy (ADR-0193 §14.2)
